en.t: The woman really had come walking over.

units.source_text: 但是，随着时间的推移，女子越来越靠近，似是越来越痛苦了。

en.t: But as time passed and the woman drew closer and closer, she seemed to be suffering more and more.

units.source_text: 她走近的同时，她那陌生的验也就逐渐清晰起来了。

en.t: As she came nearer, her unfamiliar face gradually became clearer.
